question: If 20% of a number is added to 72, then the result is the same number. 65% of the same number is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the number be N.

Given: 20% of N + 72 = N.

⇒ N − 0.2N = 72 ⇒ 0.8N = 72 ⇒ N = 72 ÷ 0.8 = 90.

65% of N = 65 ÷ 100 × 90 = 58.5.

**∴ Answer = 58.5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Percentage formula: Required value = Percentage ÷ 100 × Total.

 Total Number (N) 
• 20% of N Added 72 Final Number: N = 90

⇒ 20% of N + 72 = N.

⇒ N − 0.2N = 72 ⇒ 0.8N = 72.

⇒ N = 72 ÷ 0.8 = 90.
